---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to materials, startup or the TRAE skin workflow.
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Problem or use case

What are you trying to do, and what makes it difficult with the current behavior? Include a concrete example.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the result you would like and how someone would use it. Include a command or config example if useful; implementation details are optional.

## Success criteria

What observable behavior would show that this request is addressed?

## Alternatives considered (optional)

Describe any existing workflow or other approach you have tried.

## Additional context (optional)

Which surfaces or modes are involved? Add examples, related issues or mockups that help explain the request.
